question: Why are they called upward-semen in the kula path?
premises: Authority is the flow of semen.
In the kula path this flow is absent.
Those without flow are called upward-semen.
inference: Absence of seminal flow in the kula path defines upward-semen.
uncertainties: Grammatical gender of proktā is unclear.
plain_english: They are called upward-semen because seminal flow is absent in the kula path.
